Automated PR Cleanup

Thank you for contributing to opencode.

Due to the high volume of PRs from users and AI agents, we periodically close older PRs using automated criteria so maintainers can focus review time on the most active and community-supported contributions.

This PR was closed because it matched the following cleanup criteria:

- The PR was created more than 1 month ago
- The PR had fewer than 2 positive reactions
- Positive reactions are counted as thumbs-up, heart, celebration, or rocket reactions on the PR

PRs created within the last month are not affected by this cleanup.

If you believe this PR was closed incorrectly, or if you are still actively working on it, please leave a comment explaining why it should be reopened. A maintainer can review and reopen it if appropriate.

Thanks again for taking the time to contribute.

This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
- #29005: "Reverting doesn't actually revert the changes" — similar concern about revert behavior
- #5474: `/undo` command only rolls back conversation, not file changes — closely related undo/revert behavior
- #29520 and #29522: Similar reports of undo/revert not affecting file changes as expected

If you believe this was flagged incorrectly, please let a maintainer know.

This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
- #30683: Orphan sessions when project ID drifts — same root cause (project ID changes between restarts, old sessions become invisible in `/sessions` while still present in the database)
- #35873: Two projects sharing the same git remote URL collide into one project ID after restart — related project ID collision/drift issue
- #36222: Project sessions disappeared after updating to v1.17.18 although database still contains all sessions — same symptom (sessions in DB but not shown)

Your specific trigger (creating the first git commit causing a new project ID to be generated for the same directory) is a concrete reproduction scenario for the project ID drift bug tracked in #30683.

Tried the fix when using GPT-5.6 Sol and it worked! I had to fall back to Codex few times in the past because of this problem, and losing the session history of WIP was very annoying. I hope it gets fixed so OpenCode users don't churn, but the config change works for me for now 👌 Thank you @rayborg

> This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
> 
> * [opencode upgrade fails with 403 (doesn't respect GITHUB_TOKEN) #23461](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/23461): opencode upgrade fails with 403 (doesn't respect GITHUB_TOKEN) — same root cause and expected fix

Yes, and no. Is true that is the same root cause and expected fix, but, that bug report says:

 "When running opencode upgrade from behind a proxy/VPN, the command frequently fails with a 403 error due to GitHub API rate limiting for unauthenticated requests (60 requests/hour/IP).".

And we are reporting here, some same situation but not being behind nor proxy nor VPN. As it happens when unauthenticated requests are made by the opencode upgrade official attempt, even if GitHub is authenticated in the local system and the GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN are present in the shell environment, as available.

So, it is not a duplicate and should be addressed.

And there is also, I found there, another issue reported that is alike: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/1491 (Upgrade hitting Github rate limits
 #1491) but it is from Aug 1, 2025 and it is Closed...
Well, this seems to be another bug, I arrived at the new issue page via OpenCode's report link, which didn't have a template selection or showing any guidelines. I'll try fix my formatting.

Confirmed on the current V2 branch: the TUI was starting with an empty resolved config, so `~/.config/opencode/tui.json` never reached the keymap. With the config-loading fix applied, `leader: "ctrl+o"` works; Ctrl+O then L opens Sessions.

Video: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/4f0e1fb78ef064830856365bf7b4b92394b45eb6/artifacts/issue-36458/v2-custom-leader.mp4?raw=true

Fix branch: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/compare/v2...v2-tui-config

This PR should be reopened because it provides a complete and tested bug fix for an active issue (#31829).

The automated cleanup closed it, but the fix is still highly relevant. It resolves the UX issue where interrupting the install script (Ctrl+C) leaves the user's terminal cursor hidden and background curl processes running by adding proper INT and TERM cleanup traps.

The code is fully verified, there are currently no merge conflicts, and it is ready for maintainer review.
